name: Brotherhood Scribe
oracle_text:
Metalcraft — {T}: You get {E} (an energy counter). Activate only if you control three or more artifacts.
Whenever you get one or more {E} during your turn, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you get one or more {E} during your turn, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.

needs.what: a trigger event for a player getting one or more energy counters ('whenever you get one or more {E}'), firing once per energy-gain event with a controller filter, combinable with an is_your_turn condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine already emits EventType.ENERGY_ADDED from primitives.add_energy, but no trigger_events entry maps to it; counter_placed covers counters on permanents (and its counter key), not a player's energy, and you_gain_life/life_lost are other player events
